svg.text: CTI Feasibility Metamodel | Complete Class Diagram
39 domain entities / 102 domain attribute declarations / 62 associations / 3 generalizations
All domain entities inherit directly or indirectly from BaseEntity. Common attributes (id, type, name, description, source), optionality, methods and visibility are omitted.
Open arrows: directed associations. Hollow triangles: generalization. Blank multiplicities: unspecified. Line breaks at crossings distinguish independent connectors.
